sources.use: Inspected the Qwen-Image-2.1 backend call, transformer key mapping and official 8-bit conversion API. The adapter imports the external package at execution time; no source code was copied. Re-pinned 2026-09-25 from local fork commit cc8b86f1 (upstream 884bbd93 plus a cache.py-only change) to the shared mlx-vlm pin 67599f2e. The qwen_image diff is #2355 num_images batching only, and the convert/weights code is unchanged. Generation and edit smokes are byte-identical to the cc8b86f1 receipts.

Inspected the LTX-2.5 conversion layout and CLI contract. Applied patches/ltx25-converter-bias.patch to the local converter for ff_bias=false; patched converter SHA-256 is 2c880778d7772275b96f4eef4ee32376a29de0c94de52f4ca2b0aaccad9af98e. No source code was copied into the adapter.
Official architecture and tensor-layout reference; no weights are committed.
GGUF quantized transformer input; converted weights remain outside Git.
Distilled source checkpoint layout; no weights are committed.

modifications: New mlx2 adapter, CPU GGUF dequantization, optional CPU MLX affine 4-bit repacking, official GPU MLX affine 8-bit conversion, and a narrow bias fix to the local LTX converter; no upstream implementation copied into the adapter.
validation: CPU artifact tests, 297-key/shape GGUF conversion audit, BF16 sample parity, strict MLX loads, offline full 4-bit image pipeline load, and source-bound 512x512 20-step GPU generation/edit smokes for official 8-bit and GGUF-derived 4-bit Qwen. LTX selected snapshot completed with verified bytes and no partials; all eight CPU conversion steps completed and the direct adapter generated source-bound 9-frame 256x256 and 33-frame 512x384 H.264 GPU smokes with visual and temporal inspection. Neither adapter has serving-route qualification.
